input.quote: This Agreement shall be automatically renewed for an additional one year period on each anniversary of the Effective Date, unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other.
input.rationale: Our only exit is 90 days' notice and, if we exercise it, Section 4.2(a) imposes a Termination Payment, so we have no penalty-free convenience right; meanwhile HDI may walk away mid-term on the same notice, which the fallback permits only at the end of a term. We added a 30-day Company convenience right with a pro-rata refund and limited HDI to end-of-term non-renewal; the quantum of the Termination Payment is redlined under LD.

input.quote: unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other
input.rationale: The Agreement auto-renews for successive one-year terms with a 90-day non-renewal window, which exceeds our fallback of no more than 60 days; there is also no renewal reminder. We shortened the window to 30 days and kept the 12-month renewal term; no price-uplift cap is needed as fees are a percentage of Net Sales.

input.quote: This Agreement shall be governed and construed and enforced in accordance with the laws of the State of New York applicable to contracts made and to be performed exclusively in that State without giving effect to the principles of conflict of laws.
input.rationale: New York law is our preferred governing law and there is no arbitration provision or foreign venue. The clause is silent on forum; we would add exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County, but that is a drafting point rather than a deviation.

input.quote: This Agreement shall be binding upon, and shall inure to the benefit of and be enforceable by, the parties hereto and their respective legal representatives, successors and assigns, but no other person shall acquire or have any rights under this Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 10.3 contains no prohibition on assignment and expressly runs to successors and assigns, so we retain freedom to assign to an affiliate or an M&A successor, and there is no change-of-control termination or re-pricing right against us. This meets the fallback (mutual assignability to successors); we would prefer a consent requirement on HDI's assignments, particularly to a competitor, but the clause as drafted works in our favour and we are not redlining it.

input.quote: Except as provided herein, no licenses of the Company's Marks are granted or implied under this Agreement.
input.rationale: Nothing in the Agreement allocates ownership of the Site, work product or the customer, user and order data collected through it; we only have editorial control (5.2) and a reservation on our Marks (6.1). With HDI building and hosting everything on its own servers at its own cost, that silence leaves our deliverable and our data unprotected, so we inserted a Company ownership and Company Data clause with HDI retaining its pre-existing platform and granting us a perpetual licence to embedded HDI materials.

input.quote: HDI shall also provide the Company with access to HDI's software and Content administration tools for purposes of allowing the Company to monitor current catalog information.
input.rationale: The grant of access to HDI's system, software and administration tools runs to the Company alone, with no mention of affiliates or contractors acting for us and no path to add them, and no protection against HDI suspending or revoking access at will. We added affiliates and contractors, limited revocation to termination or our uncured material breach, and made the rights transferable to a successor.
